{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
data_sorted = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
deduplicated_data = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Convert batch B biomarker_final to ng/mL
deduplicated_data.loc[deduplicated_data['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (not relevant to response rate, but we do it anyway)
deduplicated_data = deduplicated_data[deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Final data
final_data = deduplicated_data.copy()

# Compute the response rate in each arm, unadjusted
response_rate_treatment = final_data[final_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_control = final_data[final_data['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute the raw difference (treatment - control)
difference_in_proportions = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

# Print the required value: the difference in proportions (treatment - control)
print(f'Difference in proportions (treatment - control): {difference_in_proportions:.4f}')

# Print the response rates by arm for verification
print(f'Response rate (treatment): {response_rate_treatment:.4f}')
print(f'Response rate (control): {response_rate_control:.4f}')

# Print the overall severity distribution for transparency
severity_dist = final_data['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print('\nOverall severity distribution:')
print(severity_dist)

# Print the response rates by arm and severity
stratified_rates = final_data.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='severity')
print('\nResponse rates by arm and severity:')
print(stratified_rates)"}
